position: First token of the HTTP request line
explanation: Identifies the HTTP request method. DAAP specifies that all requests are HTTP GET requests; this method field distinguishes DAAP requests from other HTTP methods at the protocol level.

position: Second token of the HTTP request line, after the method
explanation: DAAP uses the request URI path as the protocol-specific request code. Each defined path selects a different DAAP operation, such as server info, content codes, login, logout, update, database/playlist listing, or resolve, and thus determines the response type returned by the server.
